sources.cli_cost: `higgsfield generate cost <cli id>` at CLI defaults, text-only prompt (2026-10-08)
sources.observed: credits charged for test generations on one paid plan (2026-10-08); plan-dependent, not a list price

_meta.quality_tier_note: quality_tier is a PROVISIONAL 1-5 judgment, not measured. Replace with accept-rate from approval history.
_meta.unknown_policy: unknown values are null; treat a null est_credits as unknown and say so; unknown is never zero
_meta.soul_types_note: show_characters contract: type soul_2 for model soul_2, type soul_cinematic for model soul_cinematic; a Soul's type must match
_meta.routes_note: Each model lists the surfaces it can run on. mcp = mcp__higgsfield__* tools (ids per models_explore); cli = @higgsfield/cli `higgsfield generate create|cost <cli id>` (ids per `higgsfield model list --json`; the `hf` alias can be shadowed by the HuggingFace CLI, so always type the full `higgsfield` command); web = higgsfield.ai in the browser, run by a person or a browser agent from a settings checklist. CLI and MCP ids DIFFER (soul_2 vs text2image_soul_v2, nano_banana_2 vs nano_banana_flash) and so do some param names (MCP soul_id vs CLI custom_reference_id) and defaults: always pass params explicitly.
_meta.cost_note: est_credits is per route and is a public/observed price as of the `verified` date: Higgsfield prices vary by plan and change over time, so check live before spending (MCP `get_cost: true` preflight or `models_explore`; CLI `higgsfield generate cost <cli id>`; the web generate page). Read `credits_exact`, not `credits`, from an MCP get_cost preflight (`credits` is a rounded display value: soul_2 preflight returned credits 1 / credits_exact 0.12, 2026-10-08). Some models price differently per route and plan: for example Seedream 5 Lite was 1 credit via MCP and CLI (2026-10-08) but can be free on the web on plans that include it. The CLI has no unlimited option. MCP `use_unlim` draws on the FREE-TRIAL allowance only: always send use_unlim:false unless the user explicitly asks for true on that call.
_meta.best_for_note: best_for is a one-line summary for model recommendations (recommending or comparing models), taken only from ~/.claude/skills/higgsfield (image-models.md, model-guide.md, specs/model-specs.yaml) and this registry; best_for_source says which.

capability_vocabulary.image.character: image that must keep a known character's identity (Soul id or character Element)
capability_vocabulary.image.multi_ref: image built from several references (Elements and/or reference images)
capability_vocabulary.video.i2v: image to video from a start image
capability_vocabulary.video.start_end_frame: video interpolating between a supplied start frame and end frame
capability_vocabulary.video.motion_transfer: transfer motion from a reference video onto a character
